fields.label: Permanent Service Point QR
fields.description: Use one permanent QR at the location. Each scan resolves to the current open occurrence for this schedule.

fields.label: Service Point Code
fields.description: Stable scanner payload generated from this schedule.

fields.label: Recurring Task Overlap Policy
fields.options:
Prevent While Open
Allow Parallel Occurrences
fields.description: Prevent While Open keeps one actionable occurrence until it is completed. Allow Parallel creates each due occurrence independently.

fields.label: Holiday Generation Policy
fields.description: Skip Listed Holidays advances the recurrence without creating an occurrence on a listed holiday.

fields.label: Calendar Repeat (Days)
fields.description: Repeat from Next Due On by this many calendar days.

fields.label: Responsible Kanban Role
fields.description: Operational task responsibility. This is independent of ERPNext User roles and permissions.

fields.label: Optional DocType Action
fields.description: Bind one validated Action Profile to each generated task occurrence. Leave blank for a normal Service Task.

fields.label: DocType Action Profile
fields.description: Optional validated profile. Every generated task snapshots this selection so later schedule changes do not alter open occurrences.

fields.label: DocType Action Trigger
fields.options:
On Task Start
On Task Complete
After Supervisor Verification
fields.description: Start permits draft creation only. Complete uses final operator evidence. After Verification runs only after independent approval.

fields.label: DocType Action Required
fields.description: When enabled, the task remains Pending Document Posting until the profile reaches its required Draft or Submitted outcome.
